hooks.text: 操控陀螺碰撞把对手撞出场，或在持久旋转中耗到最后，以不同胜法完成竞技
hooks.excerpt: Use your spinning top to knock your opponents out or simply out last them in a battle of attrition.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 特殊陀螺能重击、筑墙防守或飞向高空再俯冲，让传统碰撞对战加入主动技能
hooks.excerpt: But these aren't your regular old battling tops, these ones have abilities. Smash at them with full force, build a wall between to defend yourself, Fly high to the sky and strike and many more abilities to choose from!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 收集并合并不同陀螺组成理想组合，再为队伍搭配能够产生协同的遗物
hooks.excerpt: Collect new tops and Combine them together to create your perfect combination and pair them up with a suitable relic !
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
